title: Dynamacophore model for breast cancer estrogen receptor alpha as an effective lead generation screening technique.
authors: Shanmugarajan, Dhivya; Biju, Anagha; Sibi, Dona; Sibi, Rona; Shaji, Maria; David, Charles
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学和药效团模型筛选乳腺癌雌激素受体α配体，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为小分子药物筛选而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Regardless to overwhelming quantum of cancer research worldwide, there are few drugs on the market to treat disease conditions. This is owing to multiple process inferences of drug targets in integrated pathways for invasion, growth, and metastasis. Over the past years, the death rate due to breast cancer has been increasing, that set the stage for improved better treatment. Therefore, there is a persistent and vital demand for innovative development of drugs to treat breast cancer. Many studies have reported that more than 60% of breast cancers are Estrogen receptor-alpha (ERalpha)-positive tumours and a key transcription factor, Estrogen receptor-alpha (ERalpha) was believed to promote proliferation of breast cancer cells. In this study, 150 ns of molecular dynamics was performed for protein-ligand complex to retrieve the potential stable conformations. The most populated dynamics cluster of 4-Hydroxytamoxifen intact with active site amino acid was selected to generate dynamacophore model (dynamic pharmacophore). Further, internal model validation with AU-ROC values  approximately 0.93 indicate the best model to screen library. The refined hits are funnelled in pharmacokinetics/dynamics, CDOCKER molecular docking, MM-GBSA and density functional theory to identify the promising ERalpha ligand candidates.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 尽管全球范围内癌症研究数量庞大，但市场上用于治疗疾病的药物却寥寥无几。这归因于在侵袭、生长和转移的整合通路中，药物靶点的多重过程干扰。过去几年，乳腺癌导致的死亡率不断上升，这为改善更优治疗奠定了基础。因此，对开发治疗乳腺癌的创新药物存在持续且至关重要的需求。多项研究报告指出，超过60%的乳腺癌为雌激素受体α（ERalpha）阳性肿瘤，且关键转录因子雌激素受体α（ERalpha）被认为能促进乳腺癌细胞的增殖。在本研究中，对蛋白质-配体复合物进行了150纳秒的分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，以获取潜在的稳定构象。选取了4-羟基他莫昔芬与活性位点氨基酸结合的最具群体动态簇，用于生成动态药效团（dynamacophore）模型（动态药效团）。进一步，通过AU-ROC值约0.93的内部模型验证表明该模型最适合用于文库筛选。精炼后的命中化合物经过药代动力学/药效学、CDOCKER分子对接、MM-GBSA和密度泛函理论（density functional theory）的筛选，以识别有前景的ERalpha配体候选物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
